programme.desc: El inspector jefe Barnaby y el sargento Scott investigan la muerte de John Ransom en Midsomer Mere.

programme.title: S08 : E06 Episodio 6: Secretos ocultos - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Nick Turner, un abogado con problemas, cae del tejado de su casa. Es un suicidio disfrazado de asesinato?

programme.title: S08 : E07 Episodio 7: La ley es igual para todos - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Cuando un corporativo trata de comprar una pequea fbrica de relish, se descubre un cuerpo en una bodega.

programme.title: S08 : E08 Episodio 8: Rapsodia de Midsomer - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Varias muertes suceden al descubrimiento de un antiguo manuscrito musical vendido barato en una subasta.

programme.title: S10 : E01 Episodio 1: Bailando con muertos - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: El asesinato de un joven da pie a la bsqueda de su novia y compaera en clases de baile de saln.

programme.title: S10 : E02 Episodio 2: Nuestro animal interior - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: La visita inesperada de Faith a su to rico Rex se convierte en una sorpresa.

programme.title: S10 : E03 Episodio 3: King's Crystal - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby investiga las rivalidades de negocios y sangre mientras Jones explora ritos masnicos secretos.

programme.title: S10 : E04 Episodio 4: El Hacha ha vuelto - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Badger's Drift son los anfitriones del festival de rock de Midsomer... con consecuencias homicidas.

programme.title: S10 : E05 Episodio 5: Muerte y polvo - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby y Jones deben investigar una serie de asesinatos en los que dos familias rivales estn involucradas.

programme.title: S10 : E06 Episodio 6: El retrato de la inocencia - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Alguien incrimina a Barnaby en los asesinatos de dos fotgrafos rivales.

programme.title: S10 : E07 Episodio 7: Lo buscan por aqu - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Estn filmando una pelcula de la Revolucin francesa en Midsomer. Algunos pierden la cabeza en la guillotina.

programme.title: S10 : E08 Episodio 8: Muerte en una caja de bombones - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby investiga el asesinato de un viejo amigo y compaero en Midsomer Holm.

programme.title: S11 : E01 Episodio 1: Boda sangrienta - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: En Barnaby ha d'afrontar un assassinat en un casament familiar

programme.title: S11 : E02 Episodio 2: Disparo al alba - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Una disputa de 90 aos entre dos familias, los Hicks y los Hammond, parece haber llegado al asesinato

programme.title: S11 : E03 Episodio 3: Dado por muerto - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Jones regresa a su pueblo natal para investigar una serie de asesinatos relacionados con sus amigos

programme.title: S11 : E04 Episodio 4: La vida de Midsomer - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Cuando hallan muerto a un hombre desaparecido dos semanas antes, Barnaby lo vincula con un editor de revista

programme.title: S11 : E05 Episodio 5: El sobrino del mago - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Las tradiciones de un culto local de Midsomer, parecen estar vinculadas a una serie de asesinatos

programme.title: S11 : E06 Episodio 6: Das de desconcierto - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Una explosin en una compaa de transportes sugiere algo mucho ms siniestro que vandalismo

programme.title: S11 : E07 Episodio 7: Hablando con los muertos - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby encuentra conexiones entre un bosque supuestamente embrujado, las desapariciones de dos parejas

programme.title: S12 : E01 Episodio 1: Asesinatos en el dogleg - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby investiga asesinatos en un club de golf vinculados a apuestas ilegales y la familia Fountain.

programme.title: S12 : E02 Episodio 2: El libro negro - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Una anciana halla un cuadro de Hogson y es asesinada; Barnaby descubre falsificación de arte.

programme.title: S12 : E03 Episodio 3: Secretos y espías - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Un esqueleto robado y asesinatos en Midsomer revelan traiciones entre exespías durante la Guerra Fría.

programme.title: S12 : E04 Episodio 4: El fallo - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby investiga el asesinato de Emily Harte, vinculando a Jeffers como objetivo del ataque.

programme.title: S12 : E05 Episodio 5: Pequeños consuelos - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: La policía investiga asesinatos en Little Worthy; Tanner, apuñalado, tenía enemistades y relaciones tensas.

programme.title: S12 : E06 Episodio 6: El mirón - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby investiga a The Creeper tras un asesinato y descubre secretos familiares y la identidad del ladrón.

programme.title: S12 : E07 Episodio 7: La flor y nata - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Connie Bishop ve un intruso; Jim Hanley es asesinado. Barnaby busca al asesino en la subasta benéfica.

programme.title: S13 : E01 Episodio 1: Asesinatos A Medida - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Sonia Woodley es hallada muerta; Barnaby y Jones investigan en Milton Cross para encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: S13 : E02 Episodio 2: La Espada de Guillaume - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby investiga un asesinato en Brighton tras sospechar fraude en la compra de tierras costeras.

programme.title: S13 : E03 Episodio 3: Sangre en la montura - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Un espectáculo en Ford Florey lleva a asesinatos, celos y disputas por un terreno baldío.

programme.title: S13 : E04 Episodio 4: La Tierra Silenciosa - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Joyce Barnaby casi atropella a alguien; luego hallan muerto a Gerald Ebbs, obsesionado con un cementerio.

programme.title: S13 : E05 Episodio 5: Clase Magistral - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Zoe Stock presencia un posible ahogamiento en Devington Manor; Barnaby y Jones investigan el caso.

programme.title: S13 : E06 Episodio 6: El Noble Arte - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: El triunfo de Kinsella en Nueva York se ensombrece por asesinatos y traiciones en Midsomer Morchard.

programme.title: S13 : E07 Episodio 7: No En Mi Jardín - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Conflictos surgen en Midsomer por Swanscombe House, revelando estafas, riñas y escándalos.

programme.title: S13 : E08 Episodio 8: En Forma Para El Asesinato - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Un fin de semana de spa se complica con un asesinato y una desaparición en Swavely Manor.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Episodio 2: Escrito en sangre - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Un grupo de escritores testigos de una serie de eventos grotescos ms all de la ficcin.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Episodio 3: Muerte de un hombre vaco - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Mientras investiga el asesinato de Agnes Gray, Barnaby se lleva alguna sorpresa.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Episodio 4: Fiel hasta la muerte - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Llaman a Barnaby cuando la mujer del dueo del centro de artesana local desaparece y asesinan a un vecino.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Episodio 5: Muerte con disfraz - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Cuando asesinan al fundador de una comuna, Barnaby enfrenta a un grupo de sospechosos extravagantes.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Episodio 2: El crimen del bosque - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby y Troy se adentran en el mundo clandestino y turbio de Midsomer Worthy.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Episodio 4: Hablar la sangre - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Llaman a Barnaby y Troy para investigar cuando el juez local, aparece muerto en su casa de Martyr Warren.

programme.title: S03 : E01 Episodio 1: Once Hombres Muertos - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Fletcher's Cross se prepara para un juego de criquet cuando asesinan a la esposa de un terrateniente local.

programme.title: S04 : E01 Episodio 1: Muerte en el jardn - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: El pueblo se levanta en armas cuando una familia odiada decide destruir un jardn conmemorativo.

programme.title: S04 : E02 Episodio 2: ngel destructor - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: El dueo de un hotel muere, y el gerente no llega a la lectura del testamento que lo nombra co-propietario.

programme.title: S04 : E03 Episodio 3: Vendetta elctrica - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: El cuerpo de un criminal es encontrado en un crculo de cosecha, y los locales culpan a los aliengenas.

programme.title: S04 : E04 Episodio 4: Quin mat a Robin? - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby y Troy llegan a Newton Magna donde debern buscar un cuerpo que fue golpeado por un auto.

programme.title: S04 : E05 Episodio 5: Otoo oscuro - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Cuando Dave Cutler, el cartero local, es encontrado con la garganta lacerada, Barnaby y Troy toman el caso.

programme.title: S05 : E01 Episodio 1: Barbitricos - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Cuando se descubre el cuerpo de una belleza local, Barnaby y Troy encuentran un mundo de adulterio y engaos.

programme.title: S05 : E03 Episodio 3: La lealtad - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Daniel Talbot muere luego de ser atacado y apualado durante la carrera anual del Da de St. Malley.

programme.title: S05 : E04 Episodio 4: El consorcio - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Barnaby y Troy investigan al club de lectura local por un incendio automovilstico y una muerte.

programme.title: S05 : E05 Episodio 5: Email clave - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Se encuentra el cadver de una mujer en el bosque Setwale, todo apunta a un suicidio.

programme.title: S06 : E01 Episodio 1: Los pescadores - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Isobel Hewitt y Duncan Goff, un doctor adltero, son asesinados mientras practican pesca con mosca en el ro.

programme.title: S06 : E02 Episodio 2: El tahr - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: Martin Wroath es encontrado muerto por un aparente suicidio, pero la autopsia muestra otra cosa.

programme.title: S06 : E03 Episodio 3: Pintado con sangre - Los asesinatos de Midsomer
programme.desc: La mujer de Barnaby halla un cadver en el parque de Midsomer Florey durante una clase de acuarela.

programme.title: S03 : E175 Strong, Light and Fast - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4 combined the best elements that Porsche could offer. In addition: the Audi R8 V10 plus, an even stronger, lighter and faster version of the original model.

programme.title: S02 : E132 Hypercars - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Mc Laren MP4 12C, the Porsche 911 Turbo S and the Mercedes SLS AMG GT are super sports cars that are second to none. We put the pedal to the metal in these exciting and powerful driving machines.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Episode 10 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel asked our presenter Miriam to participate in a driver safety training where he showed tips and tricks on what to do in emergency situations.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Episode 11 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nuerburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: S01 : E73 McLaren MP4 12C GT3 - Supercoches
programme.desc: McLaren MP4 12C GT3 jest tak szybki jak samochód Formuły 1. Zbadaliśmy, jak ten super samochód sportowy powstał. Niemiecka firma Mechatronik specjalizuje się w odnawianiu rzadkich i klasycznych samochodów, takich jak Mercedes W111.

programme.title: S01 : E74 Supercars of the Frankfurt Motor Show - Supercoches
programme.desc: We took a look at the IAA Frankfurt 2011 highlights, like the new Porsche 911, Mercedes' SLS AMG Roadster, the Bentley Continental Convertible, a 1,100 hp monster from Croatia and others.

programme.title: S03 : E157 Four Seatbelts for a Halleluja - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Porsche Panamera Turbo S is one of the most dynamic sedans in the world. In addition: the Jaguar XJR power sedan with a 550 hp V8 engine and Mercedes' extraordinary four-door coupe CLS 500.

programme.title: S01 : E16 Wildly through the desert - 4x4
programme.desc: BMW and the German racing team X-Raid take part in the Dakar Rally with a transformed Mini Countryman. Also: the Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6, a 6-wheel off-road monster. And: the Kia Sportage feels both at home in the rocky terrain of Sicily and the city.

programme.title: S01 : E39 Real Winners - 4x4
programme.desc: When BMW released the X6 in 2008, many people doubted that this concept would be successful. We took a look at the second generation of this model in the M50d version. Also: test driving the best-selling Opel Mokka. And: the Mercedes GLE Coupe.

programme.title: S02 : E49 Bizzarrini 5300 GT - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Giotto Bizzarrini był twórcą słynnego Ferrari GTO, ale po kłótniach z pracodawcą opuścił Ferrari. Aby zemścić się na Ferrari, Bizzarrini postanowił stworzyć własny samochód sportowy: Bizzarrini GT 5300.

programme.title: S02 : E60 French Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: French manufacturers have also built milestones in automotive history in the past, including lesser-known brands such as Delage and Talbot, but also vehicles from Peugeot, Renault and Citroen.

programme.title: S02 : E37 Offroad for Everybody - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Opel's Insignia Tourer Country was the German brand's first family car in outdoor attire. In addition: with the Capture Renault presented their first compact SUV. And: what happens when Fiat's cute compact 500 is inflated to the 500L Trekking?

programme.title: S02 : E51 Open Air Concert - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: As an homage to driving top-down we took a look at three of the most beautiful convertibles. The animalistic sound of the Audi S3 convertible's 4-cylinder is astonishing. But what about the Nissan 370 Z Roadster? Or Porsche's Boxster GTS?

programme.title: S01 : E07 Mercedes SLS vs Audi R8 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: S01 : E05 BMW X6M vs Nissan Patrol - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: At Jumeirah Beach in Dubai, car owners can have their souped-up vehicles judged in three categories and win an overnight stay at the Sofitel Hotel. This time, a BMW X6M, a Ford F250 and a Nissan Patrol are in the running.

programme.title: S02 : E104 Lamborghini - Supercoches
programme.desc: Sant'Agata Bolognese, the home of the iconic Italian sports car manufacturer Lamborghini, is the perfect place to take a look under the hood of the different Gallardo models. Also: cruising through Rome in an Aventador LP700-4.

programme.title: S01 : E94 Audi at Le Mans - Supercoches
programme.desc: At the 2012 Le Mans 24 Hours, Audi entered the R18 e-tron quattro for the first time. Also: the Porsche Cayenne GTS, the model between the S and the Turbo. And: the Mercedes-Benz CLS Shooting Brake.

programme.title: S01 : E17 Episode 17 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Episode 18 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nuerburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: S01 : E03 The Remote Control - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: S02 : E31 Stunt Highlights - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stunt coordinator Christoph looks back at the stunts of the last twelve shows and explains why a stunt sometimes works better in a test than on the film set. It's a summary of all the stunts of season 2, in addition to the best outtakes.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Nova SS vs Honda Accord - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Na programie Put Your Car On TV, fani samochodów z Bliskiego Wschodu mogą oceniać swoje ulubione auta pod kątem szybkości, stylu i dźwięku. W tym odcinku: Nova SS, specjalna Honda Accord i auto pokryte kryształami.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Lamborghini Aventador vs GMC Chevrolet - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: The "Walk" at JBR in Dubai is the venue for our competition, as far as fancy and luxurious cars from all over the Middle East are concerned. This time, a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet are among the participants.

programme.title: S03 : E156 Sports SUVs - Supercoches
programme.desc: Three extraordinarily sporty SUVs are the Porsche Macan Turbo, the Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and the Audi RSQ3. Each of these is able to easily cope with each season of the year and, in regards to performance, could be mistaken for a sports car.

programme.title: S03 : E152 La Dolce Vita - Supercoches
programme.desc: With the Alfieri, Maserati in 2014 celebrated their anniversary with the introduction of a beautiful grand tourer. In remembrance and as part of the three-day celebration, Maserati organised a cruise from Bologna to Torino with some of their most iconic cars.

programme.title: S02 : E31 Women and their Classic Cars - Classic Ride
programme.desc: A small group of car enthusiastic ladies offers resistance in the otherwise man dominated classic car world. One of them is Johanna. The 24-year-old loves her 1969 Corvette more than everything.

programme.title: S02 : E38 Scrapyard Gold - Classic Ride
programme.desc: It is not too unusual to find hidden gems of automotive history in a perfect condition in barns or scrap yards. Also: the MGC GT Sebring, that was built for the 12 Hours of Sebring race.

programme.title: S02 : E33 Sportscars for the Masses - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang has been an icon for decades. What makes this car so special? In addition: the Nissan 370 Z Nismo is half as expensive as a Porsche 911, but its power is on par with the German flagship. And: the 7th generation Volkswagen Golf GTI and R.

programme.title: S02 : E35 Electrically into the Future - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Tesla Model S is an icon for inventiveness and boldness. In addition: the BMW i3 was the first car from Germany that completly relied on electric propulsion. And: Citroen gave their glimpse into the future with the DS 5 Hybrid.

programme.title: S01 : E80 Ferrari FF - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Ferrari Four, also called Ferrari FF, is the first four-wheel family car from Maranello. Also: the BMW M5 shines both as a family and business car. And: the Mercedes-Benz SL is a roadster drivers' dream.

programme.title: S02 : E120 When Sports Meets Indulgence - Supercoches
programme.desc: Luxury class grand tourers with four doors. Porsche introduced their Panamera as a Plugin Hybrid or equipped with new turbo engines. BMW responded with their M6 Gran Coupe. German engineering at its finest.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Salto Mortale - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

programme.title: S01 : E03 The Remote Control - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: S01 : E21 Episode 21 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: W tym odcinku skupiliśmy się na Phoenix Racing, udanym zespole z regionu Eifel, który zdominował DTM.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Episode 11 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nuerburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: S01 : E84 Kelleners KS1 RS - Supercoches
programme.desc: BMW One M Coupe od byłego kierowcy wyścigowego Ralfa Kellenersa: KS1 RS to jedna z głównych atrakcji 2012 roku. Ponadto: kolejny wielki wycisk od Porsche, piękny kabriolet 911. I: Bentley Continental GT V8 to samochód marzeń.

programme.title: S02 : E106 Porsche to the Max - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Techart Grand GT by Porsche's house tuner is a souped-up Panamera. But the off-the-shelf GTS model also has its treats. Patrick Simon took this monster to the track. In addition: Ruf's anniversary model RT 35. And: the 911 Carrera 4.

programme.title: S01 : E27 BMW Motorrad Berlin - Motocicletas
programme.desc: The first vehicle that BMW ever produced was a motorcycle, the R23. We take a look at the brand's motorcycle factory in Berlin. Also: the KTM 125 Duke, a bike that isn't just for beginners. And: the "Night of the Jumps", an exciting freestyle motocross spectacle at Munich's Olympiahalle.

programme.title: S01 : E28 Blacktrail E-Bike - Motocicletas
programme.desc: The Blacktrail by PG Bikes is the fastest and lightest E-bike in the world, but also the most expensive. What's behind this exciting power package from Regensburg, Germany? Also: is BMW's new flagship bike, the K 1600 GT with 6 cylinders really worth its price and is it able to stand up to the competition by Honda, Kawasaki and Benelli?

programme.title: S01 : E22 Episode 22 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: At the Nuerburgring Patrick chased a 12-cylinder Aston Martin Zagato down the track. Also on the show: a Hummer, a Renault Clio and a Frenchman in a Ferrari.

programme.title: S01 : E21 Episode 21 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode, we focused on Phoenix Racing, the successful team from the Eifel Region that rocked the DTM.

programme.title: S01 : E24 The Most Exciting Classic Car Races - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Exciting GT sports cars from the 1960s, the pre-war Silver Arrows, hot classic cars on ice and historic Formula 1 cars. We present the most exciting classic car races in Germany.

programme.title: S03 : E78 Iconic Racing Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: S03 : E82 Saalbach Classic 2014 - Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the 2014 Saalbach Classic rally 80 teams raced their automobile rarities through the Austrian Alps. In addition: rally legend Walter Röhrl in a Porsche 911 RSR at the Cologne-Ahrweiler rally. And: the infamous Group B vehicle category.

programme.title: S03 : E56 Turbo Diesel Power - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: We took a look at Audi's latest generation of TDI engines and their RS5 TDI Concept. In addition we compared the advantages and disadvantages of the two main fossil fuels for cars, gasoline and diesel. And: the 2014 Porsche Cayenne Diesel.

programme.title: S03 : E57 Lightweight Cars - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The BMW i8 was one of the first sports cars with some sort of a green image. In addition we took two fly-weight sports cars, the Lotus Elise and the Roding Roadster, to one of the most beautiful alpine pass roads.

programme.title: S03 : E181 Supercars on the Rocks - Supercoches
programme.desc: Nissan's all-wheel monster GT-R had to prove its winter suitability and the new Porsche 911 with turbo engine was taken to its limits in Finnish Lapland. Also: the Mercedes-Benz S 500 plug-in hybrid.

programme.title: S03 : E179 Lightness to the Extreme - Supercoches
programme.desc: The German manufacturer Roding created a car that even outshined the Porsche GT3 with an impressive power/weight ratio. British makes like the Caterham 620 R, Lotus Elise or Radical RXC also showed what's in play in regards to lightweight sports cars.

programme.title: S01 : E01 The Fastest Cars in the World - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: Speed has always been one of the most important criteria when it comes to owning or driving a car. We show you our top 10 list of the fastest cars in the world.

programme.title: S01 : E04 The Most Expensive Production Cars - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: Everyone knows that vehicles made by hand or in small numbers can be extremely expensive. But that can also be true for production vehicles. Here are our top 10 most expensive production cars.

programme.title: S01 : E09 The Ambulance - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stunt coordinator Domi’s latest idea for the Stunt Heroes team involves an old ambulance that is prepared so that the stuntman can jump right through the ambulance with his car.

programme.title: S02 : E30 Revenge - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes rehearse a car crash scene for a movie, in which it should seem as if the main character of the movie really drives the car. The team achieves this directive by using digital effects and constructing a special airbag.

programme.title: S01 : E12 The White Army - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes leave their headquarters and travel to a ski resort. They simulate the attack of an army of soldiers all dressed in white. As part of this scene they want to make a car explode and fly through the air.

programme.title: S03 : E167 Porsche GT3 Streetracer - Supercoches
programme.desc: How do you top the already in many ways superior iconic Porsche 911? You come up with the GT3. It's the ultimate melange of road suitability and race track compatibility. And Porsche's RS model is even more intense.

programme.title: S03 : E178 Limited Edition - Supercoches
programme.desc: Tushek TS600, limitowana edycja supersamochodu miała stosunek mocy do wagi na poziomie samochodów wyścigowych GT3. Limitowana edycja Bentley Continental GT3-R była również limitowana, podczas gdy McLaren oferował swój model 570S wszystkim klientom.

programme.title: S01 : E13 The Most Successful Cars in the 24h Race - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: 24-hour races are one of the toughest tests for man and machine in motor racing. We present the most successful cars in this racing category in our Top 10 list.

programme.title: S01 : E12 The Most Unusual Cars of Modern Times - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: You often get the impression that most cars are the same. But if you are looking for something special, you will find it. We present our top 10 selection of the most unusual modern cars.

programme.title: S03 : E201 Mighty Convertibles - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Audi R8 Spyder is the most extreme convertible by the German brand. Also: the Ferrari California T scores with Italian passion and elegant lines. And: AMG's GT C Roadster with its roaring sound is a real bad boy with a touch of luxury.

programme.title: S02 : E126 International Motor Show Frankfurt 2013 - Supercoches
programme.desc: The stars of the 2013 IAA in Frankfurt were the Aston Martin Vanquish Volante, Porsche's 918 and 911 turbo models and the Jaguar F-Type coupe. Maserati introduced the Ghibli as a competition to Mercedes' E-Class and BMW's 5 series.

programme.title: S03 : E61 Classic Cars with All-Wheel Drive - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Type 166 amphibious vehicle is the all-rounder amongst off-road vehicles. Also: the Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 all-wheeler turned the World Rally Championship in the 1980s on its head. And : the Willys Jeep in our drive report.

programme.title: S03 : E71 Mobility in Eastern Europe - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the 1950s, companies like Tatra from Czechoslovakia introduced advanced, even pioneering automobiles. The clientele was exclusive, which is why now these streamlined cars are big rarities. We tracked down the owner of a 1937 Tatra T87.

programme.title: S02 : E52 The big journey - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a wolf in sheep's clothing. This station wagon has more power than the Nissan GTR 'Godzilla'. Also: the Porsche Panamera GTS feels at home on the motorway and on the race track. And: Audi's powerful all-purpose executive car RS6.

programme.title: S03 : E55 Pulse Rising Cars - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: With the Pulsar, Nissan returned to the European compact class market with a serious contender to the Volkswagen Golf. In addition: the American V8 dream sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette C7. And: Subaru's fifth-generation rally icon, the WRX STI.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Mercedes ML 63 AMG - 4x4
programme.desc: We put the Porsche Cayenne Turbo S and the Mercedes ML 63 AMG to the test. Also: the final round of the truck trial race at the Camp4fun at the Nürburgring in Germany. And: General Motors' new luxury SUV, the Cadillac SRX.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Outback Off-Road Adventure - 4x4
programme.desc: Australia's North-East is famous for its nature and wildlife. We accompanied the Germans Katrin and Uli on their 4x4 tour on the Great Tropical Drive in Queensland. Also: Clash of the Titans. We compared the Toyota Landcruiser and Mitsubishi Pajero.

programme.title: S01 : E40 Harley Sportster 1972 - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Harley-Davidson add three additions to their model range of bikes: the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, the versatile Switchback Dyna, and the bad-boy ride „Softail Slim“. Also: two German bikers take a dusty adventure ride through Mexico on their BMW's. And: the Triumph Speedmaster, the British answer to Harley-Davidson's cruiser.

programme.title: S01 : E30 Triumph Thunderbird - Motocicletas
programme.desc: The parallel twin-cylinder Triumph Thunderbird. Is the powerful 1.6 litre bike able to gain a foothold outside of the British Isles? Also: Harley-Davidson's black chopper Sportster 883 Iron, a starter bike for purists. And: Bike & Music, a spectacle for motorbike and stunt enthusiasts at Europe's biggest motorway rest area in Geiselwind, Germany.

programme.title: S03 : E175 Strong, Light and Fast - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4 combined the best elements that Porsche could offer. In addition: the Audi R8 V10 plus, an even stronger, lighter and faster version of the original model.

programme.title: S02 : E132 Hypercars - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Mc Laren MP4 12C, the Porsche 911 Turbo S and the Mercedes SLS AMG GT are super sports cars that are second to none. We put the pedal to the metal in these exciting and powerful driving machines.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Episode 10 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel asked our presenter Miriam to participate in a driver safety training where he showed tips and tricks on what to do in emergency situations.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Episode 11 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nuerburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: S01 : E73 McLaren MP4 12C GT3 - Supercoches
programme.desc: McLaren's MP4 12C GT3 is as fast as a Formula One car. We explored how this super sports car came to be. Also: the German company Mechatronik specializes in restoring rare and classic cars like the Mercedes W111.

programme.title: S01 : E74 Supercars of the Frankfurt Motor Show - Supercoches
programme.desc: We took a look at the IAA Frankfurt 2011 highlights, like the new Porsche 911, Mercedes' SLS AMG Roadster, the Bentley Continental Convertible, a 1,100 hp monster from Croatia and others.

programme.title: S01 : E84 Kelleners KS1 RS - Supercoches
programme.desc: The BMW One M Coupe from the former race-driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS is one of the highlights in 2012. Also: another big score from Porsche, the beautiful 911 cabriolet. And: the Bentley Continental GT V8 is a dream car.

programme.title: S01 : E16 Wildly through the desert - 4x4
programme.desc: BMW and the German racing team X-Raid take part in the Dakar Rally with a transformed Mini Countryman. Also: the Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6, a 6-wheel off-road monster. And: the Kia Sportage feels both at home in the rocky terrain of Sicily and the city.

programme.title: S01 : E39 Real Winners - 4x4
programme.desc: When BMW released the X6 in 2008, many people doubted that this concept would be successful. We took a look at the second generation of this model in the M50d version. Also: test driving the best-selling Opel Mokka. And: the Mercedes GLE Coupe.

programme.title: S02 : E49 Bizzarrini 5300 GT - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Giotto Bizzarrini was the creator of the famous Ferrari GTO, but after arguments with his employer he left Ferrari early. To get back at Ferrari, Bizzarrini decided to create his own sports car: the Bizzarrini GT 5300.

programme.title: S02 : E60 French Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: French manufacturers have also built milestones in automotive history in the past, including lesser-known brands such as Delage and Talbot, but also vehicles from Peugeot, Renault and Citroen.

programme.title: S02 : E37 Offroad for Everybody - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Opel's Insignia Tourer Country was the German brand's first family car in outdoor attire. In addition: with the Capture Renault presented their first compact SUV. And: what happens when Fiat's cute compact 500 is inflated to the 500L Trekking?

programme.title: S02 : E51 Open Air Concert - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: As an homage to driving top-down we took a look at three of the most beautiful convertibles. The animalistic sound of the Audi S3 convertible's 4-cylinder is astonishing. But what about the Nissan 370 Z Roadster? Or Porsche's Boxster GTS?

programme.title: S01 : E07 Mercedes SLS vs Audi R8 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: S01 : E05 BMW X6M vs Nissan Patrol - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: At Jumeirah Beach in Dubai, car owners can have their souped-up vehicles judged in three categories and win an overnight stay at the Sofitel Hotel. This time, a BMW X6M, a Ford F250 and a Nissan Patrol are in the running.

programme.title: S02 : E104 Lamborghini - Supercoches
programme.desc: Sant'Agata Bolognese, the home of the iconic Italian sports car manufacturer Lamborghini, is the perfect place to take a look under the hood of the different Gallardo models. Also: cruising through Rome in an Aventador LP700-4.

programme.title: S01 : E94 Audi at Le Mans - Supercoches
programme.desc: At the 2012 Le Mans 24 Hours, Audi entered the R18 e-tron quattro for the first time. Also: the Porsche Cayenne GTS, the model between the S and the Turbo. And: the Mercedes-Benz CLS Shooting Brake.

programme.title: S01 : E17 Episode 17 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Episode 18 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nuerburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: S01 : E03 The Remote Control - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: S02 : E31 Stunt Highlights - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stunt coordinator Christoph looks back at the stunts of the last twelve shows and explains why a stunt sometimes works better in a test than on the film set. It's a summary of all the stunts of season 2, in addition to the best outtakes.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Nova SS vs Honda Accord - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: On Put Your Car On TV, car fans from the Middle East can have their darlings rated in terms of speed, style and sound. Included this time: a Nova SS, a special Honda Accord and a car clad in crystals.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Lamborghini Aventador vs GMC Chevrolet - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: The "Walk" at JBR in Dubai is the venue for our competition, as far as fancy and luxurious cars from all over the Middle East are concerned. This time, a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet are among the participants.

programme.title: S03 : E156 Sports SUVs - Supercoches
programme.desc: Three extraordinarily sporty SUVs are the Porsche Macan Turbo, the Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and the Audi RSQ3. Each of these is able to easily cope with each season of the year and, in regards to performance, could be mistaken for a sports car.

programme.title: S03 : E152 La Dolce Vita - Supercoches
programme.desc: Z Alfierim Maserati w 2014 roku świętowało rocznicę, wprowadzając piękny samochód grand tourer. Na pamiątkę i jako część trzydniowej celebracji, Maserati zorganizowało rejs z Bolonii do Turynu z niektórymi z ich najbardziej ikonicznych samochodów.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Ron Williams and his Cadillac - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1952 Cadillac Fleetwood is also known as the American Rolls-Royce, because it’s the car of celebrities, presidents, millionaires and mafia bosses. One owner of this rare classic car is German-American actor and entertainer Ron Williams.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Porsche Carrera RS - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the early 1970s the Porsche Carrera RS was the fastest and most agile production sports car in Germany. Today the RS is a Porsche classic with highest acclaim.

programme.title: S03 : E61 Driving pleasure in winter - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Slippery or muddy roads and bad visibility are circumstances that often spoil driving pleasure in winter. We took two almost identical Porsche 911's to an icy test track. Also: drifting fun in the snow with the Suzuki SX4 S-Cross.

programme.title: S03 : E66 Parking Wars - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Not only in the big cities it's a growing struggle for parking spots. . We took the BMW X6, the Citroen Cactus and the Smart forfour to town in order to find out how these cars would cope in this situation and surrounding.

programme.title: S01 : E13 Primm 300 - 4x4
programme.desc: 500 kilometres of sand and dust. The Primm 300 is the world's toughest desert rally. We accompanied the former European Rally champion Armin Schwarz to one of his toughest challenges, from the first preparations and trial runs to the finish line.

programme.title: S01 : E15 The SUV Desert Challenge - 4x4
programme.desc: Legenda offroad'u Duncan Barbour zabrał grupę mężczyzn do Omanu, aby przetestować możliwości terenowe modeli SUV marki Mercedes-Benz. Również: jak sprawdza się Mercedes Benz GL, luksusowy SUV klasy premium na 7 osób, w miejskiej dżungli Dubaju?

programme.title: S01 : E16 Volkswagen Beetle - Made in ...
programme.desc: Historia sukcesu, która powstała w Niemczech: Volkswagen Garbus. Żaden inny samochód nigdy nie poruszył tak wielu ludzi, zarówno jeśli chodzi o odległości, jak i emocje.

programme.title: S01 : E24 Pistenbully - Made in ...
programme.desc: The Pistenbully is a made in Germany powerpack traversing the ski slopes all over the world. For over 40 years it has been the undisputed number 1 among the snow groomers.

programme.title: S01 : E35 Roding - Made in ...
programme.desc: What happens when four engineers fresh out of university are allowed to build a super sports car? One of the rarest and most unusual vehicles there is: the two-seater Roding Roadster.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Walter Röhrl - Motorheads
programme.desc: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Hans-Joachim Stuck - Motorheads
programme.desc: Hans-Joachim Stuck is one of the best racing drivers in Germany. Over his long career he not only won the Formula II and several international touring car championships multiple times but also the famous 24-hour race of Le Mans twice.

programme.title: S02 : E11 All-Wheel Vehicles for the Streets - 4x4
programme.desc: The Audi Q2 is a sportback coupe is the entry-level model for the German brand’s SUV range. Also: test-driving the SsangYong XLV lifestyle SUV. And: Mercedes present their "sportscar among SUVs", the GLC Coupe.

programme.title: S01 : E16 Wildly through the desert - 4x4
programme.desc: BMW and the German racing team X-Raid take part in the Dakar Rally with a transformed Mini Countryman. Also: the Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6, a 6-wheel off-road monster. And: the Kia Sportage feels both at home in the rocky terrain of Sicily and the city.

programme.title: S01 : E20 Tuning World - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: For more than 20 years the Tuning World Bodensee has been one of the top events in the European car tuning scene. Also: with their i-models BMW started to explore alternative drive technologies. And: taking the Nissan Leaf to Oslo.

programme.title: S01 : E21 All New! - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Following the Porsche 911's anniversary we take a look back at this iconic model's history. Also: the world's first series-produced plug-in hybrid with a diesel engine, the Volvo V60. And: safety measures in the car world, from seatbelts to crash tests.

programme.title: S01 : E29 Enduro Park Hechlingen - Motocicletas
programme.desc: The BMW Enduro Park Hechlingen in Bavaria offers off-road driving pleasure both for beginners and pros alike on 26 hectares. We take a look at what this exciting place has to offer for enduro enthusiasts. Also: what does the inexpensive Hyosung ST 700 i from South Korea have to offer? And: the big-wheeled scooter from Taiwan, the Kymco People GT 300i.

programme.title: S01 : E30 Triumph Thunderbird - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Równoległy dwucylindrowy Triumph Thunderbird. Czy potężny motocykl o pojemności 1,6 litra zdobędzie uznanie poza Wyspami Brytyjskimi? A także: czarny chopper Harley-Davidsona Sportster 883 Iron, motocykl dla purystów. I: Bike & Music, spektakl dla entuzjastów motocykli i akrobacji w największym europejskim węźle autostradowym w Geiselwind w Niemczech.

programme.title: S03 : E78 Iconic Racing Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.desc: It's getting hot in this episode of Stunt Heroes. Stuntman Paul will be engulfed by flames as everything around him blows up in this dangerous fire stunt. The Action Concept team carefully prepares for this heated scene.

programme.desc: The Tushek TS600, a limited edition super sports car had a power/weight ratio that is on the level of GT3 racing cars. The Bentley Continental GT3-R special edition was also limited whereas McLaren offered their 570S to all customers.

programme.desc: Wyścigi trwające 24 godziny to jedna z najbardziej wymagających prób dla ludzi i maszyn w wyścigach samochodowych. Prezentujemy najskuteczniejsze samochody w tej kategorii wyścigów w naszej liście Top 10.
